one_line: An 11-second recommendation that says what, from where and from what age in the first sentence, with a comment-word offer.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a wrapped tablet swept across a wooden table, blurred; 0:01 a hand lifts the lid of a box with a cartoon girl. Voice (transcript): "המלצה למשחק משיין: לוח ציור וכתיבה מחיק". One-word subtitles: "למשחק", "משיין,", "וכתיבה".
q1_hook.why: The first sentence names what it is, where it is from and the minimum age, said and written at once (H1, H2, H6). A fast sweep and an unboxing give motion inside 2 s (E1). But it is a plain recommendation, not a problem or a result, and no face or child opens it (H4).

beats.what: The wrapped tablet sweeps in; the box lid opens, a manual and the wrapped tablet; first sentence
beats.why: Says and shows what it is at once

beats.what: A hand pulls the wrapped tablet out; "לשרבט"
The blue tablet on the table; a hand writes small letters with a stylus; "לתרגל... אותיות ומספרים"
beats.why: Each use shown as it is named

beats.what: Held upright, a house and trees are drawn; the bin icon is visible; "ולמחוק בלחיצה"
beats.why: Drawing and the erase button together

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: "רוצה קישור? כתבי לי ״לוח״ בתגובות ואשלח לך בפרטי". Nothing in the video asks for a comment, send or save.
q2_flow.why: A new view or action every 2 to 3 s, with no dead air, keeps it moving (R3, R1). At 11 s it fits a single product moment (R2). Each use is shown as its word is said, so demo and line are one (R3). The ending, the erase button, is a small payoff, not a peak (R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption, near the end: "רוצה קישור? כתבי לי ״לוח״ בתגובות ואשלח לך בפרטי 💌". The comment word is "לוח".
q3_cta.why: A named Hebrew keyword in return for a link, a real thing, is the clearest CTA form (C3, R6, C2). It is one action (C1). But it is only in the caption, never said or shown in the video, and the word is the generic product word (C6).

q4_shown.what: A wrapped tablet and a box with a cartoon girl, 0:00 to 0:04; a blue LCD writing tablet, a hand writing letters 0:05 to 0:08; held upright, a house and trees drawn, the bin icon visible 0:08 to 0:11. No face, no child, no price.
q4_shown.why: The product is on screen and handled from 0:00 (S1). Hands only carry the Reel (S4), and no child's face is shown (S5). The product is a SHEIN item named in speech and caption with no brand on screen, so it is a light sell (C7). The proof is only the creator's own use (S6).

q5_edit.what: 6 shots in 11 s by detection (two cuts at 8.07 and 8.13 s, so 5 in effect), about 2 s each; straight cuts. One-word subtitles change about every second. No speed change. The first shot is a motion-blur sweep. Ends mid-drawing, on "בלחיצה".
q5_edit.why: A cut at 1.4 s and movement from frame zero open well (E1). A moderate cut pace within one scene fits (E2). One-word subtitles synced to the voice serve sound on and off (E4, T2). It stops on the last word, with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A reusable drawing and writing tablet for a toddler from age one and a half, used for scribbling, letters and games; serves a parent seeking a clean, portable activity.
q6_topic.why: A practical, travel-friendly play item answers a real parent need (K6), with a modest benefit line in the caption (K4). The Reel has no high-arousal peak and no occasion or gift moment (K1, K7). A useful find is easy to send to another parent (R5).

q7_filmed.what: Phone close on a light wooden table in even daylight against a pale wall: handheld for the sweep and unboxing, static for the writing and the upright drawing; one hand with a ring and bracelet; no face.
q7_filmed.why: Hands put the viewer in the seat (F5), and the tablet fills the frame, so the drawing reads on a phone (F4). All live, bright and clean, with a homemade feel (F8, F7).

q8_text.on_screen: One word at a time, white bold with a thin outline, centred about 75% down, changing about each second: "למשחק" (0:00), "משיין," (0:01), "וכתיבה" (0:02), "מגיל" (0:03), "לשרבט," (0:04), "לתרגל" (0:05), "אותיות" (0:06), "איקס" (0:08), "בלחיצה" (0:10). No headline, no CTA.
q8_text.caption: "לוח קטן, המון אפשרויות לציור ולמשחק ✍🏼✨". About 78 words: the use and the age, a skills line, the erase benefit, "רוצה קישור? כתבי לי ״לוח״ בתגובות", 5 hashtags (#הורות #פעילותלילדים #ילדים #ריפויבעיסוק #המלצות). No disclosure.
q8_text.why: One-word subtitles of the speech make it work muted (T1, T2), but each word is on screen for about a second, in the bottom band (T5, T4). The caption's first line has keywords, with 5 mostly generic hashtags (T7). It sends a link with no wording on any commercial tie; none is known (T8).

weak_points: A very generic comment word; no disclosure although the caption sends a link; one-word subtitles in the bottom band; no child or result shown; the proof is only the creator's own use.
lumebook_takeaway: Film an 11 s unboxing: the first sentence says what the book is and for what age, one-word subtitles, and a comment-a-word offer in the caption.
not_verified: Whether the link is an affiliate link or the creator is paid or gifted (no label). Whether she is an OT (hashtag only). Music. Whether the screen is erased on camera: the bin icon is visible but the erase is not seen in my frames. Correction to coded file: the index finds 6 shots (two cuts 0.06 s apart); the last frame is the drawing with "בלחיצה".
